summary: Reversal of acquittal; standard: clearly unreasonable/perverse judgment with compelling reasons; eyewitness credibility doubtful; forensic evidence inconclusive; Appellant as interested witness; double presumption of innocence after trial; Suman Chandra/Allarakha Mansuri standards applied; impugned order affirmed; appeal dismissed against respondents' acquittal for murder under IPC ss.302,307,etc.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order upholding acquittal sustained.
